nl.title: phpMyAdmin openen en databases importeren of exporteren in CyberPanel
nl.excerpt: phpMyAdmin openen en databases importeren of exporteren in CyberPanel: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
phpMyAdmin in CyberPanel laat je databases bekijken, importeren en exporteren. Werk altijd met backups bij destructieve queries.

Stappen

  1. Open Databases → phpMyAdmin (of de knop bij de DB).
  2. Selecteer de database van de website.
  3. Export: SQL-dump downloaden vóór grote wijzigingen.
  4. Import: .sql uploaden; let op max upload size.

Let op: Drop table / lege database = site down. Geen experimenten op productie zonder restoreplan.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: Databasegebruikers; DB-only backup.

en.title: PhpMyAdmin open and databases importeren or exporteren in CyberPanel
en.excerpt: CyberPanel: select website, correct module (SSL/DNS/Email/Files/Backup), purge OLS cache.
en.bodyHtml:
In CyberPanel select the website first. For “PhpMyAdmin open and databases importeren or exporteren in CyberPanel” then open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — depending on the task.

Preparation

  • CyberPanel URL + login
  • Domain name

Steps

  1. Sign in to CyberPanel (port 8090 or welcome link).
  2. Go to Websites and open the correct domain.
  3. Choose the module: SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager, Databases or Backup.
  4. Apply the change and save.
  5. Purge OpenLiteSpeed cache if the site shows old content.
  6. On 500/white screen: open Error Logs for that website.

Verify

  • Change visible on the live URL
  • No new errors in the logs

Tip: Note old DNS/SSL values before you save.

Note: Selecting the wrong website changes another site’s production.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: CyberPanel login, SSL, OLS cache.
